bleu_definition: mean over ids of nltk sentence_bleu([vllm.split()], mlx.split(), SmoothingFunction().method1)
note: Same rate on both engines (0.53) and 79/100 identical texts: the MLX bf16 anonymizer reproduces vLLM. The gap to the paper's 0.37 is therefore not caused by the MLX port; it lies elsewhere (attacker model and prompt, scoring, or code drift).
